products.name: Ideogram
products.note: Text-in-image generation; typography AI; commercial use; IP and copyright considerations

profile_text.body:
Ideogram describes itself as a generative media platform that brings together purpose-built creative apps, image and video model access, and a unified API under one roof. Its own site positions the platform around Ideogram 4.0, an open model whose weights are available for local use and customization under its applicable license, and which can also be accessed through Ideogram's hosted platform. The unified API handles authentication, usage, and billing across supported image and video models through a single endpoint, with model switching managed by changing a model string in a request.

The company offers several discrete tools alongside its core model, including an Ad Resizer for reformatting a single creative across ad sizes, a Background Remover for generating transparent PNGs with what the site describes as studio-quality edges, and an Object Remover for erasing elements from photos. It also lists a model family called P-Image-Ideogram, described as a set of Pareto optimal image models balancing quality, latency, and cost. The tracked product entry notes text-in-image generation and typography as central capabilities, along with commercial use availability and IP and copyright considerations as relevant factors for users.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the held facts for Ideogram.
